newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kyushu refinery unaffected by morning quake.
newsitem.headline: Kyushu refinery unaffected by morning quake.

text.p: Operations at Kyushu Oil Co Ltd's Oita refinery were not affected by an earthquake measuring 5.5 on the Richter scale that hit Japan's southern island of Kyushu early on Thursday, a company spokesman said.
"Nothing has been disrupted at the plant, including cargo loading and unloading," he said.
The tremor occurred at 4.33 a.m. on Thursday (1933 GMT on Wednesday), the Meteorological Agency said.
The Oita refinery, with a crude processing capacity of 136,000 barrels a day, is about 210 km (130 miles) from southern Kyushu's Kagoshima Prefecture, where the quake was felt hardest.
Kyushu Oil's Oita refinery is the only refinery on the island.
